title: Locate the target object by checking multiple storage surfaces
description: Use when the required object is not visible in the current location or initial search area.
content: When searching for an object, inspect nearby shelves or similar storage surfaces one by one until the target object is found. The object may be on a different shelf than the first one checked.

title: Transport multiple objects one at a time between locations
description: Use this when a task requires moving multiple items from one location to another and the agent can only carry one item at a time.
content: When moving multiple objects to a target location, take one object from the source, go to the destination, place it there, then return to the source for the next object. Repeat this cycle until all required objects have been moved.

title: Search multiple storage locations before giving up
description: Use when looking for a target object that is not in the first few containers or surfaces checked.
content: When searching for an object like a mug, systematically check all cabinets and countertops in the environment rather than stopping after the first empty location. The target object may be on a countertop rather than inside a cabinet, so include both container types in the search.

title: Cool an object by taking it to the fridge and using the cool action
description: Use this when a task requires cooling an object such as a mug.
content: To cool an object, first pick it up, then go to the fridge, ensure the fridge is open, and use the cool action with the fridge. The object does not need to be placed inside; the cool action can be performed while holding it near the open fridge.

title: Open containers before moving on
description: When searching for an object in closed containers
content: Open each closed container you encounter before moving to the next one, even if you suspect it's empty, to avoid missing hidden items.

title: Verify destination surface before placing objects
description: Use this when placing an object onto a target surface to confirm the correct location.
content: Before moving an object to a destination, go to the destination and examine what is already there to ensure it is the correct surface, then place the object onto it.

title: Verify destination contents before and after placement
description: Use this when placing objects at a destination to confirm successful transfer.
content: After moving an object to a destination, check the destination's contents to confirm the object is present. This verification step helps track progress when multiple objects need to be moved to the same location.

title: Locate eggs in the fridge
description: Use this when a task requires obtaining an egg or other refrigerated food item.
content: Eggs are typically stored in the fridge. Go to the fridge, open it if closed, and take the needed egg before proceeding with other task steps.

title: Place items into a microwave
description: Use this when a task requires putting an item into a microwave.
content: Go to the microwave, open it if closed, and then move the item into the microwave. The microwave may already contain other items, but you can still place the target item inside.
